items.html: And by means of this raising of Mayin Nukvin, Aba and Ima couple, and from the illumination of that coupling they build and correct the female, and draw down into her other mochin in that point which is in her. And she grows, and nine other points are added to her, and she becomes a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot, and she stands with him back to back, from his Chazeh and below. And this building is done by means of the casting of the deep sleep (Durmita) upon ZA.
